responsibility: Declares the DJGPP-specific command-line option additions used by the x86 DOS target. In this module it mainly contributes the driver-level -posix option entry so the GCC option parser and specs machinery can recognize the DJGPP environment’s POSIX compatibility switch.
same_name_distinction: Unlike djgpp.h and djgpp.cc, this file only declares the DJGPP-specific driver option spelling posix; it neither defines the DJGPP target configuration nor implements its assembler/LTO hooks.
